items.summary: Recommendation: defer both new CRO prototypes and prioritize measurement, attribution reconciliation, and backlog burn-down. The 2026-09-24 snapshot shows $887.67 of AI spend from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-24 versus only $4.92 Amazon commission recorded for 2026-09-21, all in an unattributed aggregate row; site-attributed commission is $0. True contribution margin, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, fixed-cost exposure, and ROI are not calculable because infrastructure, hosting/domain, labor, and comparable-period revenue costs are absent. The 30-day scorecard has 0 proven improvements, 23 awaiting measurement, 132 approved proposals without execution requests, and 13 failed-request repairs open. Do not authorize incremental prototype effort until existing work is measured and a report-only cost/attribution boundary is completed. Keep SearchWoot private; no finance approval for outreach or launch changes.

Revenue claims are not supported beyond the recorded provider totals: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21. The $4.92 is explicitly aggregate and cannot be assigned to a site; named site rows show $0 attributable income. SEO totals of 13,599 impressions, 135 clicks, 963 sessions, and 15 conversions are traffic/conversion signals, not revenue or profit. No forecast, payback, or positive margin claim should be retained.

Recommendation: defer new CRO prototypes and prioritize measurement, attribution reconciliation, and backlog burn-down. Current evidence supports no site-attributed commission, positive margin, ROI, forecast, or payback claim. Keep SearchWoot private pending its unresolved gates.

Financial claims are limited to provider totals: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21. Site-attributed commission is $0; ROI, payback, forecast, and contribution margin are unsupported.
